Join a group that meets regularly, such as Toastmasters.

Find a local community that shares you interests. What do you like to do? I'm currently involved in about 3 local communities. The metal scene here is absolutely amazing and I've been making friends with all the local bands and all the regular concert goers. People in music scenes tend to be amazingly friendly so I'd definitely start there if you're interested in music at all. I'm also in the RPG/DnD and kink communities. Everyone is super friendly.

Find some groups that do stuff that you're interested in. Sports, Gaming, Volunteer work, etc.

Whenever someone asks you, if you want to do something, always say "Yea, sure, I'll be there." (unless you think you really won't like the activity or people). Be a Yes-man, until you get to know more people. There are no good excuses to not hang out, you always have to push past the feeling of "I'm tired" or "I don't feel like it". Just get out, do something, anything that helps you meet new people.

What are your hobbies? Go do those outside. You'll meet people.

Join a choir. Almost every town and city has some sort of social singing. If you really can't sing, find a singing teacher, and in a couple of months you'll be ready to join a choir (probably recommended by your singing teacher).

Join a running club. Again, almost every town and city has a running or jogging club. Just call up the contact number. If you can't run, join the local "weightwatchers club".

Volunteer at the local hospital. People of all ages can act as hospital volunteers, either visiting patients or helping visitors. Or volunteer at the local old people's home. Oldsters will appreciate you, and many of them will have sons or daughters or grandsons or granddaughters closer to your age, and they'll probably be happy to introduce you after a couple of weeks.
